# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_RIBBON_FLIP

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sudden volatility spike (ATR expansion) coupled with an EMA8/EMA21 cross often precedes a short impulsive move that can be captured with a tight stop. This trigger aims to capture the momentum burst following volatility expansion and ribbon alignment, which is not currently in the registry.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When ATR(5) > 1.5 × ATR(20) AND EMA8 crosses above EMA21 (for long) or below EMA21 (for short) within the same bar, enter at the close of that bar in the direction of the cross. Exit shape: Initial stop at the prior swing point (chart-stop); target at 1.5 R or at the opposite EMA (EMA55) acting as a dynamic stop; optional trail of 10 % off the highest‑water‑mark after 1 R is reached. Regime hint: Effective when VIX > 18 (elevated volatility) and after the first 30 minutes of trade to avoid opening‑range noise.
